title: Software Engineer - .NET
description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. Job Description The Software Engineer (.NET/Azure) is a hands-on, mid-level contributor responsible for designing, building, and modernizing high-volume, high-transaction applications across the Experian Employer Services (EES) organization. You will write production code, participate in code reviews, evaluate SAST findings, and work closely with product, quality engineering, security, and operations partners to deliver secure, reliable software to our clients and partners. AI and automation are the main focus of our team. EES is adopting an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) and spec-driven agentic development, in which teams define intent, constraints, acceptance criteria, and validation before AI agents build approved work. As an engineer in this model you will work from versioned specifications, direct AI coding agents to implement approved work, and oversee the review, testing, and security validation of what they produce. You will have already worked this way hands-on; this is a requirement of the role, not a learning goal. Humans remain accountable for technical decisions, data protection, and production outcomes. At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian. This hybrid role reports to the Engineering Manager, Application Engineering, and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs: Costa Mesa, CA; San Jose, CA; Allen, TX; Austin, TX; Franklin, TN; New York, NY; Schaumberg, IL; Washington, D.C.; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA Responsibilities: Analyze new feature requirements with attention to design, software development best practices, testing strategy, database design, security, and cloud architecture, and turn them into clear, versioned specifications with explicit acceptance criteria that engineers and AI agents can verify. Use AI coding assistants and agents (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to implement approved work, and own the review, testing, and security validation of AI-generated code before it is merged. Decide when a change needs additional human review based on its risk. Build new and modernize existing .NET applications, APIs, and partner integrations, including responsive, accessible web UIs that work across devices. Write high-quality, well-tested code: unit tests, integration tests, and contract tests, with observability built in. Automate repetitive engineering and operational work (pipelines, environment setup, test data, deployments) rather than performing it by hand. Maintain the team's reusable agent instructions, skills, and coding standards for the codebase, and help teammates use agentic tools well. Participate in code reviews and provide meaningful feedback on human-written and AI-generated code alike. Follow Experian's Secure SDLC. Evaluate and resolve SAST findings, handle sensitive and personal data safely, and never expose such data to AI tools or non-production environments without approved controls. Resolve defects identified by quality engineering and demonstrate completed functionality to the Product team for approval. Promote a DevOps culture, work with IT and operations, and participate in the on-call rotation for platform emergencies. Work within Agile and Scrum delivery while adapting planning and reporting as specifications and system-generated evidence replace ceremony-driven tracking. Qualifications Hands-on experience with spec-driven agentic development (mandatory). At least one year of personally using AI coding assistants or agents on production code: working from specifications, constraining the agent's scope, testing and reviewing its output, and deciding what requires human approval. Experience working within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI DLC) or a comparable spec-driven model with explicit specifications, automated validation, and human oversight. 6+ years of professional .NET development experience with C#, .NET 8+ (and .NET Framework for maintenance of existing systems), and ASP.NET Core. 2+ years building and operating solutions on Azure, including services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor. Experience with MS SQL Server, T-SQL, relational database design, and Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM. Experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and partner integrations, including authentication, versioning, and error handling. Solid front-end experience with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and one modern SPA framework (Angular or React). Experience with service oriented or microservice architecture, messaging, and common cloud-native patterns. Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, Git branching workflows, and automated testing in the pipeline. Working knowledge of secure coding practices, SAST remediation, and handling of sensitive and personal data. Experience with Agile and Scrum delivery. Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience building GenAI-enabled features with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or similar, including retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and output evaluation. Familiarity with Agent Skills or similar standards for reusable agent instructions and workflows. Experience with Playwright or similar end-to-end testing frameworks. Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications and integrating acquired technologies into an existing product ecosystem. Azure certifications such as AZ-204 or AZ-400. General Requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 6+ years of professional .NET development experience 2+ years of Azure cloud experience 1+ year of hands-on spec-driven agentic development within AI DLC or a comparable model (mandatory) Additional Information Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay range for this position is listed above. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity. Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity. Benefits/Perks: Great compensation package and bonus plan. Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K. Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office. Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays. Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://myexperianbenefits.com/. We design, develop, and deliver high-quality enterprise systems, as well as systems integrations and work in a project-based consulting environment.
